<a id="page-commerce"></a>
# Commerce (feature layer)

The commerce layer: a paywall's actions (buy, restore, select a product, close, open a legal link). Open it when a UI sells something. Its words and actions are allowed only where the host enables the layer (see [levels.md](levels.md)).

<a id="commerce-actions"></a>
## Actions

Written in an event as their type and fields by name, as on [events.md](events.md#events-actions).

<a id="action-paywall"></a>
### `paywall`: Paywall

A paywall interaction: buy the selected (or `slot`'s) product, restore purchases, select a product, close the paywall, open a legal `url`, or open a server-resolved `placement`.

Written `paywall operation=… placement=…`. Level 5.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | `purchase` `restore` `selectProduct` `closePaywall` `openLegalLink` `openPaywall` | `purchase` |  |
| `placement` | text |  | The server-resolved placement to open. |
| `offer` | text |  | storeDefault, trial, or standard; expressions allowed. |
| `slot` | text |  |  |
| `url` | text |  | A legal link. |
| `transition` | `platform` `none` `fade` `fadeUp` `slideUp` `slideLeft` `scale` | `platform` | openPaywall: how its screen opens. |
| `transitionMs` | whole number |  |  |
| `reverseTransitionMs` | whole number |  |  |
| `routeTransition` | [RouteTransition](navigation.md#type-RouteTransition) |  | openPaywall: a custom transition for its screen; replaces transition and its times. |
